# V-One Hospital

> > V-One Hospital is a multi-specialty trauma center and emergency medical facility in Indore offering comprehensive diagnostic imaging, surgical specialties, and specialized treatment across neurology, cardiology, oncology, and rehabilitation.

V-One Hospital is a leading healthcare provider in Indore, India, specializing in trauma care, emergency services, and multi-specialty treatment. The hospital features advanced diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT, EEG), experienced specialist doctors, and departments ranging from neurosurgery and cardiology to oncology and physiotherapy.

## Key Topics

- Trauma Center & Emergency Care
- Neurosurgery & Neurology
- Cardiology & Interventional Cardiology
- Oncology & Head-Neck Cancer
- Diagnostic Imaging (MRI, CT, EEG)
- Orthopedics
- Plastic & Cosmetic Surgery
- ENT (Ear, Nose, Throat)
- Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
- Clinical Pathology Lab
- Anesthesia & Pain Management
- Nutrition & Dietetics
- Interventional Radiology
- Doctor Directory
- Online Appointment Booking

## Medical Specialties & Departments

- [Consult the Top Neurologist Doctor in Indore - V-One Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-neurosciences): Neurology and neurosurgery: stroke, epilepsy, brain tumor treatment
- [Seek Treatment from Best Cardiologist in Indore - V-One Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-cardiac-diseases): Cardiology: heart disease treatment, interventional cardiology services
- [Best Oncologist in Indore | Head and Cancer Surgeon - V-One Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-head-and-neck-cancer): Head and neck cancer treatment by experienced oncologists in Indore
- [Best Plastic and Cosmetic Surgeon in Indore - V-One Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-facial-plastic-surgery-unit): Facial plastic surgery: cosmetic procedures, rhinoplasty, facelift in Indore
- [Consult the Best ENT Specialist in Indore - V-One Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-ear-nose-and-throat): ENT services: ear, nose, throat disorders with laser-assisted surgery
- [Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation by Physiotherapists in Indore](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-physiotherapy-rehabilitation): Physiotherapy and rehabilitation: pain management and mobility restoration
- [Anaesthesia and Pain Management in Indore - V-One Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-anaesthesia-pain-management): Anesthesia and pain management for surgical procedures and recovery
- [Department of Nutrition and Dietetics - V-ONE Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-nutrition-and-dietetics): Nutrition and dietetics department with personalized nutrition plans

## Diagnostic & Laboratory Services

- [Department of Radiology & Imaging - V-ONE Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-radiology-imaging): Radiology and diagnostic imaging: MRI, CT scans, CAT scans services
- [Interventional Radiologist in Indore | Advanced Patient Care](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-interventional-radiology): Interventional radiology: minimally invasive angioplasty and embolization
- [Pathology Lab in Indore with Best Clinical Laboratory Services - V-One Hospital](https://www.vonehospital.com/department/department-of-laboratory-science): Clinical pathology lab: histopathology, cytopathology diagnostic testing
